blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senate President Sherwin Gatchalian on Saturday ensured that the Senate impeachment court will uphold fairness in the ongoing trial of Vice President Sara Duterte. Gatchalian was asked to comment on the statement of Duterte on Friday that she is “preparing for the worst” on the verdict of the impeachment court on her trial. “Makakaasa naman ang taumbayan na magiging patas ang impeachment court at magiging fair ang impeachment court lalo na pagdating sa ebidensya at pagtanggap ng ebidensya,” Gatchalian said in an interview with DWIZ.
